Which statement about ethanoic acid is correct?
A
It contains a –COOH group.
B
It has a pH greater than pH 7.
C
It reacts with sodium carbonate to form hydrogen gas.
D
It reacts with copper to form copper(II) ethanoate.

options.label: B
options.text: It has a pH greater than pH 7.

options.label: C
options.text: It reacts with sodium carbonate to form hydrogen gas.

options.label: D
options.text: It reacts with copper to form copper(II) ethanoate.
